text:
Based on NASA FIRMS data from multiple sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) covering the period 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, no thermal anomalies (indicative of burning) were detected on the property. All days were fully monitored by each sensor.

While this confirms no major or sustained fires occurred, small, short-lived, or obscured fires cannot be ruled out. The evidence does not address burned areas, causes of changes (e.g., harvesting), or activity outside the specified period. Overall, the data strongly supports no significant burning took place during the assessed interval.
